name: fintech-app
behavior: Onboarding shows once, then phone number + one-time code, then the tabs. Signing out returns to sign in. The session is saved on the device (AsyncStorage) and guarded with Expo Router’s Stack.Protected.
Home (scrubbable revenue chart, KPIs, pull to refresh), Cards (swipe between cards, reveal the number or CVV, freeze), Pay (payee, amount, slide to send) and Profile.
A transfer made on Pay appears at the top of Home’s transactions straight away. The send itself is a stand-in — call your payments API from the slider’s onConfirm.
Pushed from Profile. Appearance (System / Light / Dark) re-themes every kit component instantly.

SMS code handlers in app/sign-in.tsx and the transfer in components/fintech-app/pay-screen.tsx are stand-ins that wait and succeed. Cards, payees and the dashboard numbers live in lib/fintech-app/data.tsx.
